purpose: Independent temporal context for selected transcript contrasts and focused Hallmark time-by-treatment interactions
external_role: independent context; not replication or validation

gene_display.selection_status: selected during exploratory inspection; secondary descriptive analysis
gene_display.estimator: unshrunk DESeq2 log2 fold change with 95% Wald CI
gene_display.fits: separate old-animal treatment models at 6 h and 48 h

hallmark_display.estimator: mouse MSigDB 2026.1.Mm Hallmark NES ranked by signed DESeq2 time-by-treatment Wald statistic
hallmark_display.interaction: (48-h exposure minus control) minus (6-h exposure minus control)
hallmark_display.multiplicity: BH FDR across all 50 Hallmark gene sets

claim_ceiling: Between-experiment difference in treatment-associated contrast compatible with, but not identifying, a temporal difference
limitation: Different animals at 6 h and 48 h; time is inseparable from deposited matrix and any unrecorded time-aligned processing or sequencing-batch effects; not a trajectory, replication, or validation
